title: fix: restore strict lint for state and maintenance owners
body:
Related: #156121

## What Problem This Solves

Strict local validation rejects the oversized deferred-maintenance owner, blocking preparation of otherwise unrelated changes.

## User Impact

Developers can complete strict validation again. This is an internal cleanup with no user-visible behavior change.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing maintenance task builder moves into the maintenance work module that its caller already loads, reducing the scheduling owner from 710 to 685 code lines. Native hook relay mutations also reuse the shared worker's existing write options. Transaction admission, task metadata, settlement, cleanup, and lint policy are preserved.

## Evidence

- Strict oxlint, formatting, and `git diff --check` pass for all three changed files on the updated base.
- Reused focused proof: 39 tests passed across native hook relay storage, context maintenance, and synchronous preparation (197.30 seconds wall, including transforms). This run predates the base update; it is not a fresh full-suite or exact-head execution.
- Independent Codex review found no actionable P0–P2 findings. The three-file patch is identical across the mechanical base update.
- [Fresh exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35931957207) passed for `136f42c7d68f6c9e1f830c4e6de5c4972de94822`, including all required CI gates.

The [first CI run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35927606917) failed in a deferred-maintenance disposal deadline, a session-delivery clock-jump integration timeout, and a Watch invocation round trip. The updated base includes [the disposal-fixture fix](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c947420a323614f7b0d637652d238f2c5db965bd), which waits for durable task publication before starting the unchanged disposal checks. A bounded source audit found no changed dispatch, scheduling, settlement, or mock boundary explaining the two Gateway failures; a failing base replay has not been run, so their causes remain unresolved. No assertion or deadline changes are included in this PR.

The successful fresh run also includes an existing watchdog retry in [extension bundle 18](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35931957207/job/107420736639). Its first Codex group attempt reported seven 180-second hook timeouts in `run-attempt.settlement.test.ts`, then stalled; the retry passed all 107 cases in 127.77 seconds. A bounded log/source audit found unchanged settlement fixtures and cleanup owners, and no changed native-hook request or transaction-admission behavior explaining the timeout. The log does not identify the stalled hook await, and no failing base replay or independent reproduction was run. This remains unresolved; the passing retry is not evidence of a fix.

No tests, dependency versions, schemas, or lint policies change in the PR diff.
